source_text:
21.4 Σὺ
δὲ ἐν ἁγίῳ κατοικεῖς, ὁ ε παινος ̓Ισραήλ. ̓Εντεῦθεν μανθάνομεν ο τι αὐτοέπαινός
ἐστιν ὁ Κύριος καὶ ἐπαινούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ ̓Ισραὴλ, η αὐτὸς ε παινος ω ν.
pass_a_gloss: You and in holy dwell, the praise of-Israel. From-here we-learn that self-praise is the Lord and being-praised by the Israel, or himself praise being.
pass_b_english: “But you dwell in the holy place, the praise of Israel” (Psalm 21:4).
From this we learn that the Lord is self-praise and is praised by Israel, or himself being praise.

choices.why: αὐτοέπαινος is the Lord, not Israel praising itself. OCR ε παινος.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
